data.name: income_recurrence_templates
constraints:
CHECK ((frequency = 'monthly' AND monthly_reference_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31) OR
            (frequency = 'by_period' AND monthly_reference_day IS NULL))
CHECK (frequency IN ('monthly', 'by_period'))

CHECK ((value_mode = 'fixed' AND default_amount_centavos IS NOT NULL) OR
            (value_mode = 'variable' AND default_amount_centavos IS NULL))
CHECK (value_mode IN ('fixed', 'variable'))

CHECK (
      default_amount_centavos IS NULL OR (
        length(default_amount_centavos) BETWEEN 1 AND 19
        AND default_amount_centavos NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
        AND (default_amount_centavos = '0' OR
            substr(default_amount_centavos, 1, 1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9')
        AND (length(default_amount_centavos) < 19 OR
            default_amount_centavos <= '9223372036854775807')
      )
    )
FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id) REFERENCES categories (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id, subcategory_id) REFERENCES subcategories (owner_id, category_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (subcategory_id IS NULL OR category_id IS NOT NULL)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_preferences" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "theme" TEXT NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'America/Sao_Paulo', "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "onboarding" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "tools" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "reports" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "period_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_start_day" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), CHECK ((mode = 'calendar_month' AND custom_start_day IS NULL) OR
            (mode = 'custom_cycle' AND custom_start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31)), CHECK (mode IN ('calendar_month', 'custom_cycle')), CHECK (id = owner_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'category', "color_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gray', PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), CHECK (kind IN ('income', 'expense')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subcategories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id) REFERENCES categories (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, UNIQUE (owner_id, category_id, id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "income_recurrence_templates" ("description" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "starts_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "monthly_reference_day" INTEGER NULL, "value_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_amount_centavos" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "subcategory_id" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), CHECK ((frequency = 'monthly' AND monthly_reference_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31) OR
            (frequency = 'by_period' AND monthly_reference_day IS NULL)), CHECK (frequency IN ('monthly', 'by_period')), CHECK ((value_mode = 'fixed' AND default_amount_centavos IS NOT NULL) OR
            (value_mode = 'variable' AND default_amount_centavos IS NULL)), CHECK (value_mode IN ('fixed', 'variable')), CHECK (
      default_amount_centavos IS NULL OR (
        length(default_amount_centavos) BETWEEN 1 AND 19
        AND default_amount_centavos NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
        AND (default_amount_centavos = '0' OR
            substr(default_amount_centavos, 1, 1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9')
        AND (length(default_amount_centavos) < 19 OR
            default_amount_centavos <= '9223372036854775807')
      )
    ), FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id) REFERENCES categories (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id, subcategory_id) REFERENCES subcategories (owner_id, category_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK (subcategory_id IS NULL OR category_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_recurrence_templates" ("description" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "starts_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "monthly_reference_day" INTEGER NULL, "value_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_amount_centavos" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "subcategory_id" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), CHECK ((frequency = 'monthly' AND monthly_reference_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31) OR
            (frequency = 'by_period' AND monthly_reference_day IS NULL)), CHECK (frequency IN ('monthly', 'by_period')), CHECK ((value_mode = 'fixed' AND default_amount_centavos IS NOT NULL) OR
            (value_mode = 'variable' AND default_amount_centavos IS NULL)), CHECK (value_mode IN ('fixed', 'variable')), CHECK (
      default_amount_centavos IS NULL OR (
        length(default_amount_centavos) BETWEEN 1 AND 19
        AND default_amount_centavos NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
        AND (default_amount_centavos = '0' OR
            substr(default_amount_centavos, 1, 1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9')
        AND (length(default_amount_centavos) < 19 OR
            default_amount_centavos <= '9223372036854775807')
      )
    ), FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id) REFERENCES categories (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id, subcategory_id) REFERENCES subcategories (owner_id, category_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK (subcategory_id IS NULL OR category_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "investment_recurrence_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "starts_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "monthly_reference_day" INTEGER NULL, "default_amount_centavos" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), CHECK ((frequency = 'monthly' AND monthly_reference_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31) OR
            (frequency = 'by_period' AND monthly_reference_day IS NULL)), CHECK (frequency IN ('monthly', 'by_period')), CHECK (
      length(default_amount_centavos) BETWEEN 1 AND 19
      AND default_amount_centavos NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
      AND (default_amount_centavos = '0' OR
          substr(default_amount_centavos, 1, 1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9')
      AND (length(default_amount_centavos) < 19 OR
          default_amount_centavos <= '9223372036854775807')
    ));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "income_entries" ("description" TEXT NULL, "amount_centavos" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "subcategory_id" TEXT NULL, "recurrence_template_id" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_for_date" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_on" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, recurrence_template_id) REFERENCES income_recurrence_templates (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id) REFERENCES categories (owner_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, category_id, subcategory_id) REFERENCES subcategories (owner_id, category_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK (
      amount_centavos IS NULL OR (
        length(amount_centavos) BETWEEN 1 AND 19
        AND amount_centavos NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
        AND (amount_centavos = '0' OR
            substr(amount_centavos, 1, 1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9')
        AND (length(amount_centavos) < 19 OR
            amount_centavos <= '9223372036854775807')
      )
    ), CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'received', 'cancelled')), CHECK (status <> 'received' OR
            (received_on IS NOT NULL AND amount_centavos IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (amount_centavos IS NOT NULL OR recurrence_template_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (status <> 'pending' OR received_on IS NULL), CHECK (subcategory_id IS NULL OR category_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "old_snapshot_json" TEXT NULL, "new_snapshot_json" TEXT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "applied_sync_operations" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "result_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "applied_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "idempotency_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remote_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolution_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_retry_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "idempotency_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_order_value" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "source_table"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_bill_cards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "closing_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), CHECK (closing_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31), CHECK (due_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_bill_purchases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchased_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "installment_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, card_id) REFERENCES card_bill_cards (owner_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (installment_count BETWEEN 1 AND 24), CHECK (amount_mode IN ('total', 'installment')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_bill_installments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchase_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "invoice_month" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_centavos" TEXT NOT NULL, "manually_edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("manually_edited" IN (0, 1)), "paid_outside" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("paid_outside" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, purchase_id) REFERENCES card_bill_purchases (owner_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE (owner_id, purchase_id, number));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_bill_subscriptions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "monthly_amount_centavos" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_month" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, card_id) REFERENCES card_bill_cards (owner_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_bill_charges" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "subscription_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "invoice_month" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_centavos" TEXT NOT NULL, "manually_edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("manually_edited" IN (0, 1)), "removed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("removed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), UNIQUE (owner_id, subscription_id, invoice_month));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_bill_invoices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "invoice_month" TEXT NOT NULL, "closing_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "dates_manual" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dates_manual" IN (0, 1)), "informed_amount_centavos" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "payment_id" TEXT NULL, "paid_amount_centavos" TEXT NULL, "paid_on" TEXT NULL, "payment_source" TEXT NULL, "reserve_used_centavos" TEXT NULL, "expected_amount_centavos" TEXT NULL, "card_name" TEXT NULL, "items_snapshot" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), UNIQUE (owner_id, card_id, invoice_month), CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid')), CHECK (status <> 'paid' OR payment_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_bill_reserve_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_centavos" TEXT NOT NULL, "invoice_id" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "id"), CHECK (kind IN ('adjustment', 'payment', 'payment_undo')), CHECK (direction IN ('in', 'out')));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX unique_income_occurrence_schedule ON income_entries (owner_id, recurrence_template_id, scheduled_for_date) WHERE recurrence_template_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX unique_expense_occurrence_schedule ON expense_entries (owner_id, recurrence_template_id, scheduled_for_date) WHERE recurrence_template_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX unique_investment_occurrence_schedule ON investment_allocations (owner_id, recurrence_template_id, scheduled_for_date) WHERE recurrence_template_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX audit_events_operation_idx ON audit_events (owner_id, operation_id, entity_id, operation)
CREATE INDEX sync_outbox_state_idx ON sync_outbox (owner_id, state)
